as_told.title: McConnell recalls a source visibly shaking

plain: Kurt McConnell, a former staff member for the US Senate, says that between about 2017 and 2024 people came to Capitol Hill in Washington to tell senators and staff what they knew about unexplained phenomena. He recalls one source who was visibly shaking as they began to explain, and in a second conversation with podcast host Jesse Michels he describes such sources more generally as earnest people with credible backgrounds who were nervous and trembling, which he takes as a sign of how serious they were.
